description.en: The overseas possessions of England and later the United Kingdom, from the first chartered trading companies and colonies of the early 1600s to the handover of Hong Kong in 1997. They included colonies in North America and the Caribbean, rule in India first by the East India Company and then by the Crown, and much of Africa. The empire carried more than a million enslaved Africans to its Caribbean colonies, and famines struck British-ruled India.
description.es: Los dominios de ultramar de Inglaterra y después del Reino Unido, desde las primeras compañías comerciales y colonias con carta real de principios del siglo XVII hasta la entrega de Hong Kong en 1997. Incluyeron colonias en Norteamérica y el Caribe, el dominio sobre la India, primero por la Compañía de las Indias Orientales y después por la Corona, y buena parte de África. El imperio llevó a más de un millón de africanos esclavizados a sus colonias caribeñas, y hubo hambrunas en la India bajo dominio británico.
description.zh: 英格兰以及后来的联合王国的海外属地，始于17世纪初最早的特许贸易公司和殖民地，止于1997年香港交接。其中有北美和加勒比的殖民地、先由东印度公司后由王室统治的印度，以及非洲的大片土地。帝国把一百多万被奴役的非洲人运到加勒比殖民地，英属印度也发生过饥荒。

sources.citation: Wikidata, "British Empire" (Q8680): "overseas possessions of England and later the United Kingdom (1607–1997)".
Encyclopedia.com, "British East India Company": the English East India Company was set up in 1600.
Encyclopedia.com, "British Empire": Hong Kong was returned to China in 1997, leaving Britain a scattering of rocks and islands around the globe.

note.en: The start is dated to 1600, when the East India Company was chartered, or to 1607, when the Jamestown colony was founded, which is the start Wikidata uses. The end is dated to the Hong Kong handover in 1997; Britain still holds some overseas territories.
note.es: El inicio se fecha en 1600, cuando se fundó la Compañía de las Indias Orientales, o en 1607, con la fundación de la colonia de Jamestown, que es el inicio que usa Wikidata. El final se fecha en la entrega de Hong Kong en 1997; el Reino Unido conserva aún algunos territorios de ultramar.
note.zh: 起点或定为1600年东印度公司成立，或定为1607年詹姆斯敦殖民地建立，后者是维基数据采用的起点。终点定为1997年香港交接；英国至今仍保有一些海外领地。

title.en: The Virginia Company of London founds Jamestown, the first permanent English settlement in North America
title.es: La Compañía de Virginia de Londres funda Jamestown, el primer asentamiento inglés permanente en Norteamérica
title.zh: 伦敦弗吉尼亚公司建立詹姆斯敦，这是英格兰在北美的第一个永久定居点

sources.citation: World History Encyclopedia, "Jamestown Colony of Virginia": the first permanent English settlement in North America, founded in 1607 by the Virginia Company of London.
Encyclopedia.com, "British Empire": the Virginia colony was re-established in 1607 and this time survived.

title.en: East India Company forces under Robert Clive win the Battle of Plassey, and the Company begins to hold territory in India
title.es: Fuerzas de la Compañía de las Indias Orientales al mando de Robert Clive ganan la batalla de Plassey, y la Compañía empieza a poseer territorio en la India
title.zh: 罗伯特·克莱武率领的东印度公司军队赢得普拉西战役，公司开始在印度占有领土

sources.citation: Encyclopedia.com, "British East India Company": Robert Clive defeated the challenge of the French company and captured Bengal in 1757.

World History Encyclopedia, "Battle of Plassey": on 23 June 1757 Robert Clive's East India Company army defeated a larger force of the Nawab of Bengal; the victory brought the Company wealth and began its territorial expansion.

title.en: The thirteen American colonies declare independence on 4 July; Britain loses them by the end of the war, which curtails what is often called the first British empire
title.es: Las trece colonias americanas declaran su independencia el 4 de julio; el Reino Unido las pierde al terminar la guerra, lo que recorta lo que suele llamarse el primer imperio británico
title.zh: 北美十三个殖民地于7月4日宣布独立；英国在战争结束时失去这些殖民地，常说的第一英帝国就此缩小

sources.citation: Office of the Historian, U.S. Department of State, "The Declaration of Independence, 1776": adopted on 4 July 1776, it severed the 13 colonies' political connections to Great Britain.
Encyclopedia.com, "British Empire": the 'First Empire' was curtailed by the loss of 13 colonies at the end of the American Revolution (1775-81).

title.en: Parliament passes the law that abolishes the British slave trade
title.es: El Parlamento aprueba la ley que abole el comercio británico de esclavos
title.zh: 议会通过废除英国奴隶贸易的法律

sources.citation: Encyclopedia.com, "Abolition Movement": after repeated defeats, the law that abolished the British slave trade passed Parliament in 1807.
Encyclopedia.com, "Atlantic Slave Trade": Great Britain abolished the trade in 1807.

note.en: The law ended the British slave trade, not slavery in the colonies, which lasted until the Slavery Abolition Act took effect.
note.es: La ley puso fin al comercio británico de esclavos, no a la esclavitud en las colonias, que continuó hasta que entró en vigor la Ley de Abolición de la Esclavitud.
note.zh: 该法律终结的是英国的奴隶贸易，而不是殖民地的奴隶制；奴隶制持续到《废除奴隶制法案》生效。

title.en: The Slavery Abolition Act frees the enslaved in the British colonies from 1 August 1834, and the system effectively ends in 1838
title.es: La Ley de Abolición de la Esclavitud libera a los esclavizados de las colonias británicas desde el 1 de agosto de 1834, y el sistema termina de hecho en 1838
title.zh: 《废除奴隶制法案》规定英属殖民地的被奴役者自1834年8月1日起获得解放，该制度于1838年实际终结

sources.citation: legislation.gov.uk, "Slavery Abolition Act 1833": all slaves in the British Colonies emancipated from 1 August 1834, subject to the obligations the Act imposes.
Encyclopedia.com, "Slavery": the British government abolished slavery throughout its empire in 1834, effectively ending the institution in 1838.

note.en: The Act was passed in 1833 and took effect on 1 August 1834. Encyclopedia.com dates the effective end of the institution to 1838. The Act's obligations on the freed people lasted until then.
note.es: La ley se aprobó en 1833 y entró en vigor el 1 de agosto de 1834. Encyclopedia.com fecha el fin efectivo de la institución en 1838. Las obligaciones que la ley imponía a los liberados duraron hasta entonces.
note.zh: 该法案于1833年通过，1834年8月1日生效。Encyclopedia.com将该制度的实际终结定在1838年。法案对获释者规定的义务持续到那时。

title.en: Sepoys of the Bengal army rise against British rule in May 1857, and in 1858 the Crown takes over the East India Company's rule in India
title.es: Cipayos del ejército de Bengala se alzan contra el dominio británico en mayo de 1857, y en 1858 la Corona asume el gobierno de la Compañía de las Indias Orientales en la India
title.zh: 1857年5月孟加拉军队的印度兵起兵反抗英国统治，1858年王室接管东印度公司在印度的统治

sources.citation: Encyclopedia.com, "Indian Mutiny": on 10 May 1857 sepoys of the Bengal army shot their British officers and marched on Delhi; the revolt was put down and direct rule by the British Crown replaced the East India Company's administration.
Encyclopedia.com, "British East India Company": the 1857 revolt led to the company's powers being transferred to the British Crown.

note.en: Encyclopedia.com calls the rising the Indian Mutiny and notes that in India it is known as the first war of independence. It says armed resistance lasted until spring 1859.
note.es: Encyclopedia.com llama al levantamiento Motín de la India y señala que en la India se conoce como la primera guerra de independencia. Dice que la resistencia armada duró hasta la primavera de 1859.
note.zh: Encyclopedia.com称这场起事为印度兵变，并指出在印度它被称为第一次独立战争。该文称武装抵抗持续到1859年春。

title.en: British India is divided into the two self-governing dominions of India and Pakistan in mid-August
title.es: La India británica se divide en los dos dominios autónomos de la India y Pakistán a mediados de agosto
title.zh: 英属印度于8月中旬分为印度和巴基斯坦两个自治领

sources.citation: Encyclopedia.com, "Pakistan": on 14 August 1947 British India was divided into the two self-governing dominions of India and Pakistan; more than 20 million people moved, and up to three million of them were killed.
Indian Independence Act 1947, section 1 (legislation.gov.uk): as from 15 August 1947 two independent Dominions were set up in India, India and Pakistan.

note.en: The Indian Independence Act names 15 August 1947 as the day both dominions were set up. The Encyclopedia.com article on Pakistan dates the division to 14 August. Deaths in the partition are contested: that article says up to three million were killed, among more than 20 million who moved.
note.es: La Ley de Independencia de la India fija el 15 de agosto de 1947 como el día en que se crearon ambos dominios. El artículo de Encyclopedia.com sobre Pakistán fecha la división el 14 de agosto. Las muertes de la partición son discutidas: ese artículo dice que murieron hasta tres millones de personas, entre más de 20 millones que se desplazaron.
note.zh: 《印度独立法》规定1947年8月15日为两个自治领成立之日。Encyclopedia.com关于巴基斯坦的条目把分治定在8月14日。分治造成的死亡人数有争议：该条目称，在两千多万迁徙者中，最多有三百万人死亡。

title.en: Britain and France, with Israel, attack Egypt after it nationalises the Suez Canal Company, and accept a UN ceasefire on 6 November
title.es: Reino Unido y Francia, junto con Israel, atacan Egipto tras la nacionalización de la Compañía del Canal de Suez, y aceptan un alto el fuego de la ONU el 6 de noviembre
title.zh: 埃及将苏伊士运河公司收归国有后，英国和法国联合以色列进攻埃及，并于11月6日接受联合国停火

sources.citation: Office of the Historian, U.S. Department of State, "The Suez Crisis, 1956": Egypt nationalised the Suez Canal Company on 26 July 1956; Britain and France accepted a UN ceasefire on 6 November under US pressure.

Encyclopedia.com, "Suez Crisis": Israel attacked Sinai on 29 October, British and French planes began bombing Egyptian bases on 31 October, and the United States sponsored a UN ceasefire resolution that left Britain and France isolated.

title.en: Britain hands Hong Kong over to China on 1 July, under the 1984 Sino-British Joint Declaration
title.es: El Reino Unido entrega Hong Kong a China el 1 de julio, conforme a la Declaración Conjunta Sino-Británica de 1984
title.zh: 英国根据1984年《中英联合声明》，于7月1日将香港交给中国

sources.citation: Encyclopedia.com, "Hong Kong": the hand-over to China in 1997 was stipulated in the Sino-British Joint Declaration of 19 December 1984.
Encyclopedia.com, "British Empire": Britain kept a scattering of rocks and islands, but even Hong Kong was returned to China in 1997.

text.en: Encyclopedia.com says British Caribbean plantations, mainly on Barbados and Jamaica, received almost one and a half million enslaved Africans, 23 percent of the Atlantic trade.
text.es: Encyclopedia.com afirma que las plantaciones del Caribe británico, sobre todo en Barbados y Jamaica, recibieron casi un millón y medio de africanos esclavizados, el 23 por ciento del comercio atlántico.
text.zh: Encyclopedia.com称，英属加勒比的种植园，主要在巴巴多斯和牙买加，接收了近一百五十万被奴役的非洲人，占大西洋贩奴贸易的23%。

sources.citation: Encyclopedia.com, "Slavery": the British Caribbean plantations (mainly Barbados and Jamaica) received almost a million and a half slaves, 23 percent of the trade.
Britannica, "History of Barbados": Barbados became a sugar island in the 1640s, and the Royal African Company and other traders brought increasing numbers of enslaved Africans there.
Encyclopedia.com, "Atlantic Slave Trade": Great Britain abolished the trade in 1807.

text.en: Encyclopedia.com says severe famines struck India under British rule in the 18th and 19th centuries, and that the last major one was the Bengal famine of 1943 to 1944.
text.es: Encyclopedia.com afirma que hubo hambrunas graves en la India bajo dominio británico en los siglos XVIII y XIX, y que la última de importancia fue la hambruna de Bengala de 1943 a 1944.
text.zh: Encyclopedia.com称，英国统治下的印度在18和19世纪发生过严重饥荒，最后一次大饥荒是1943至1944年的孟加拉饥荒。

sources.citation: Encyclopedia.com, "Famine": severe famines occurred in India under British rule in the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries; the last major famine under British rule was the Bengal famine of 1943 to 1944.
Britannica, "Famine" (entitlement failure): the Bengal famine of 1943 killed some three million people; British wartime stockpiling and exports of food made it worse.
